sean leon.bio: Toronto rapper, singer, songwriter and producer Sean Leon is an independent Canadian artist whose IXXI Initiative helped foster Toronto talent and whose writing credits extend to major international releases.

super duty tough work.bio: Winnipeg art-rap ensemble Super Duty Tough Work recreates the dusty jazz-sample feel of 1990s East Coast hip-hop with a live band, politically charged writing and meticulously arranged performances.

susan aglukark.bio: Inuk singer-songwriter Susan Aglukark blends Inuit musical traditions with pop and country songwriting, becoming a groundbreaking Canadian recording artist and the first Inuk performer to win a Juno Award.

suzie mcneil.bio: Mississauga-born singer-songwriter Suzie McNeil is a Canadian pop-rock vocalist and multi-instrumentalist whose solo career followed national exposure on Rock Star: INXS.

swollen members.bio: Vancouver hip-hop group Swollen Members, founded by Madchild and Prevail, became one of Canada's most successful underground rap acts through the independent Battle Axe movement and a run of Juno-winning releases.

sylvain cossette.bio: Québec singer-songwriter Sylvain Cossette is a long-running French-Canadian pop and rock artist whose solo career followed his years with the English-language band Paradox.
